nodes.label: Feature: GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Feature document describing GLUE Cloud accounts, GLUE Home device app, synchronization, remote libraries, uploads, downloads, cross-device duplicates

nodes.label: Accounts (Google, email+password)
nodes.rationale: Optional tier; sign in with Google or email; cloud keeps only identity and device list, never library data or music

nodes.label: GLUE Home device app
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app (Windows, macOS); streams songs to other devices; analyses and writes library; small always-on-top drag dock window for DJ app interop

nodes.label: Devices model
nodes.rationale: Browser that holds music is device; one that only looks is browse session; GLUE Home is home (companion of its computer's browser); pairing by code

nodes.label: Pairing GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: Two ways: code from signed-in website (short-lived, single use), or same account (GLUE Home opens browser to sign in)

nodes.label: Remote library
nodes.rationale: Open device to see collections, playlists, tags, ratings, analysis (read-only); stream with seeking; download tracks/playlists/selections; copy to this computer

nodes.label: Upload to incoming folder
nodes.rationale: Drop files on GLUE Home device (or pick in Add songs); written to incoming folder with progress, resume, checksum; GLUE Home scans them into library

nodes.label: Duplicates across devices
nodes.rationale: Same recording (fingerprint) or same file (size + hash) on two devices; rows get device badge; Duplicates view has device column

hyperedges.label: Multi-device library: shared collections, one per computer id, same file on two computers is one song with copies on each
